title.en: Which printed window fits this check: does the Electric 10 Series fit a 25 m rural line
title.zh: 这一问只对一个窗口：电动10系列对得上 25 米的农村管路吗

description.en: Taken from the printed row: Yes, when the horizontal run stays inside 25 m and the stone is 2 cm and below. Keep this cell as published. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints rural self-built houses, small sites and secondary structure on the Electric 10 Series: 15 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.1 m³, horizontal 25 m, 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm and 400 kg. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The table does not print a vertical distance. Read it in the Xingtai table. This page will not invent one.
description.zh: 可以，只要水平不超过 25 m，石子在 2 cm 及以下。河北品锦机械（邢台）在电动10系列上印了农村自建房、小型工地和二次结构：15 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.1 m³、水平 25 m、外形 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm、400 kg。表上没有垂直距离。本页不编一个。

body.en: This block keeps the heading “U-Bends Expansion Compensator Calculator” from “Steel Pipes Expansion Loops - Design and Calculation”, then stays with the cells already published. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints rural self-built houses, small sites and secondary structure on the Electric 10 Series: 15 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.1 m³, horizontal 25 m, 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm and 400 kg. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. 23 MPa. Keep this cell as published. body.zh: 本节保留《Steel Pipes Expansion Loops - Design and Calculation》的标题“弯管膨胀计算器”，正文仍只谈已经公布的格子。目录里已经写着：可以，停在已印的水平格内：15 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、水平 25 m、骨料 2 cm 及以下、400 kg。没有印垂直格。按邢台表上的原文理解：电动40也印了 21 m³/h，但是 45 kW，细石 120 m / 360 m，机架 2300 kg。输送量数字相同，应用句和距离不同。电动10系列料斗是 0.1 m³。电动40料斗是 0.4 m³。旁边那一台不在这句话里。印了。23 MPa。这和电动15不同，电动15没有压力格。图来自来源页面：https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/steel-pipe-expansion-loop-d_1069.html

body.en: The section shape comes from “Z-Bends Expansion Compensator Calculator” in “Steel Pipes Expansion Loops - Design and Calculation”. The sentences are a restatement of the catalogue, not of that article. Keep this cell as published. No vertical cell is printed. Taken from the printed row: The table does not print a vertical distance. Read it in the Xingtai table. The two-to-three-floor sentence on the Electric 15 note stays on Electric 15. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Same output figure, different application sentence and different distance. Keep this cell as published. Send horizontal metres only if you measured them, and say the vertical cell is absent from this table. Taken from the printed row: Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print. Read it in the Xingtai table. That is unlike Electric 15, which does not print a pressure cell. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. No.
body.zh: 这一节的形状来自《Steel Pipes Expansion Loops - Design and Calculation》的“弯管膨胀计算器”。文字是目录的转述，不是那篇文章的原文。这一格照已印出的读：可以，只要水平不超过 25 m，石子在 2 cm 及以下。邢台河北品锦机械在电动10系列上印了农村自建房、小型工地和二次结构：15 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.1 m³、水平 25 m、外形 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm、400 kg。表上没有垂直距离。本页不编一个。目录里已经写着：只有量过才发水平米数，并说明这张表没有垂直格。按邢台表上的原文理解：不一样。电动10系列印的是 2 cm 及以下。

body.en: “Steel Pipes Expansion Loops - Design and Calculation” breaks its subject at “L-Bends Expansion Compensator Calculator”. Here the same break only holds the cells this model already prints. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Yes, when the horizontal run stays inside 25 m and the stone is 2 cm and below. Keep this cell as published. This page will not invent one. Taken from the printed row: A rural line longer than 25 m horizontal leaves the Electric 10 Series even if the motor size looks the same. Read it in the Xingtai table. The Electric 10 Series hopper is 0.1 m³. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Keep this cell as published. Yes. Taken from the printed row: No. Read it in the Xingtai table. Only horizontal 25 m is printed. Headings already printed: 15 kW does not copy Electric 15’s metres 21 m³/h is not the Electric 40 building row
body.zh: 《Steel Pipes Expansion Loops - Design and Calculation》在“弯管膨胀计算器”处把题目拆开。这里这一段只放这台机器已经印出的格子。旁边那一台不在这句话里。电动15也是 15 kW，但它印的是 8–10 m³/h、垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m、骨料 1–3 cm、450 kg。电动15说明里的两三层那句话留在电动15上。农村管路水平长于 25 m 时，即使电机看起来一样，也要离开电动10系列。这一格照已印出的读：请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。目录里已经写着：没有。只印了水平 25 m。已印出的标题：15 kW 不会抄来电动15的米数 21 m³/h 不是电动40的建筑行

question.en: Is outlet pressure printed, once the outline says “U-Bends Expansion Compensator Calculator”?
question.zh: 大纲写着“弯管膨胀计算器”时，印了出口压力吗？

answer.en: Taken from the printed row: Yes. 23 MPa. That is unlike Electric 15, which does not print a pressure cell.
answer.zh: 目录里已经写着：印了。23 MPa。这和电动15不同，电动15没有压力格。

question.en: Under “Z-Bends Expansion Compensator Calculator”, is 2 cm the same as Electric 15’s 1–3 cm?
question.zh: 在“弯管膨胀计算器”这一节里，2 cm 和电动15的 1–3 cm 一样吗？

answer.en: Keep this cell as published. No. Electric 10 Series prints 2 cm and below.
answer.zh: 这一格照已印出的读：不一样。电动10系列印的是 2 cm 及以下。

answer.zh: 旁边那一台不在这句话里。没有。只印了水平 25 m。
